Even if all of them gather together intending to harm you, they cannot do you any harm (beyond) except what Allah has (decreed and) written for you. The pens (that write destiny) have been lifted (after finishing writing the decrees). The ink of the scrolls (on which the decrees were written) has dried (not the slightest change can be made to the decisions written in destiny). Know this!” said the Prophet ﷺ.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَقِيقَةٌ وَمَا بَلَغَ عَبْدٌ حَقِيقَةَ اْلإِيمَانِ حَتَّي يَعْلَمَ أَنَّ مَا أَصَابَهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِيُخْطِئَهُ وَمَا أَخْطَأَهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِيُصِيبَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد والطبراني ورجاله ثقات ورواه الطبراني في الاوسط مجمع الزوائد:٧ /٨٢٤٠٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “Every thing has a reality. A slave will not attain the reality of Iman until he firmly believes that any (good or bad) matter that reached him (in this world) could never (under any circumstances) have missed him, and that any (good or bad) matter that did not reach him could never (under any circumstances) have reached him!” said Rasulullah ﷺ. Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrates this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- A person should understand that all the states that come upon him - whether his state is one his heart likes, or he is pushed into a state his heart does not like - all of these have been decided by Allah.
